newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Peters sees 95 pct chance of NZ govt by Dec 13.
newsitem.headline: Peters sees 95 pct chance of NZ govt by Dec 13.

text.p: New Zealand First leader Winston Peters said on Monday he was 95 percent hopeful of reaching a coalition agreement with the caretaker National Party government or the Labour opposition "well before" December 13, the date by which parliament must reconvene.
"I'm hoping, probably about 95 percent, that we're going to make it well before that date," Peters said in a television interview.
Nationalist New Zealand First has been negotiating with both National and Labour since an inconclusive general election on October 12 which left it holding the balance of power.
Peters would not say if he expected a deal this week or next.
Peters said the final decision on a coalition would be made democratically by his party's parliamentary caucus and council.
